svg.aria-label: Engineer clearance badge and field telemetry
svg.title: Engineer clearance badge and field telemetry
svg.desc: A swinging red-and-gold clearance badge for Amit Tiwari, Sr. Full-Stack .NET Engineer, based in Ahmedabad, active since 2012, with a Level 4 stamp. Beside it: 14+ years shipping, 6 certifications, 6 awards, 6+ client launches; a career log from Lumium Innovation (2012–2014) to Xtreem Cyber Security (2014–2016) to Allscripts, now Altera (2016–now); and a systems check of core, cloud, UI and engineering-practice skills.
